corporate-blue.description: Corporate Blue preset — professional, trust-forward palette with a deep blue primary and cool neutral greys. Suitable for B2B dashboards, enterprise tools, and financial interfaces.

dark-minimal.description: Dark Minimal preset — sleek dark-mode palette with a green accent and low-chroma slate neutrals. Suitable for developer tools, code editors, terminal UIs, and monitoring dashboards.

startup-warm.description: Startup Warm preset — friendly, approachable palette with a coral primary and warm neutrals. Suitable for consumer apps, onboarding flows, and creative tools.
